Hello and welcome! 

Here you can find the online and interactive platform application from the VHP4Safety Project. 

In order to run the current version of the application locally through Docker, please run the following command: 

`docker run -d -p [PORT]:5050 vhp4safety/virtual-human-platform:latest`

where `[PORT]` is a number that you can pick, e.g., `5000`. You can then see the application by opening a web browser and navigating to `http://localhost:[PORT]` where `[PORT]` should be the same number you used in the command above. For instance, after using `5000` in the `[PORT]` above, the application will be available at [http://localhost:5000/](http://localhost:5000/). 

Alternatively, one can run a specific version available by using the command:

`docker run -d -p [PORT]:5050 vhp4safety/virtual-human-platform:[VERSION_NUMBER]`

To see the available version numbers, please see the [tags page](https://hub.docker.com/r/vhp4safety/virtual-human-platform/tags). See below for version logs. 

## Platform

You can find a running instance of the application at [https://platform.vhp4safety.nl/](https://platform.vhp4safety.nl/). 

The source files of the application can be found in our GitHub Repository, [VHP4Safety/virtual-human-platform](https://github.com/VHP4Safety/virtual-human-platform). 

Version logs with more detail on development can be found in the [version logs](https://github.com/VHP4Safety/virtual-human-platform/blob/main/version_logs.txt) in the same repository. 

## VHP4Safety Project

For more information about VHP4Safety Project and its research outputs, please see the links below: 
- [Project Webpage](https://vhp4safety.nl/)
- [Virtual Human Platform](https://platform.vhp4safety.nl/)
- [The tool catalog](https://cloud.vhp4safety.nl/)
- [The documentation website](https://docs.vhp4safety.nl/)



VHP4Safety – the Virtual Human Platform for safety assessment project [NWA 1292.19.272](https://www.nwo.nl/projecten/nwa129219272) is part of the NWA research program ‘Research along Routes by Consortia (ORC)’, which is funded by the Netherlands Organization for Scientific Research (NWO).
